claims.claim: University of Guelph research shows raising entire male pigs could cut Canadian swine GHG emissions by 11.2 percent per kg carcass weight.
claims.episode_span: University of Guelph research shows raising entire male pigs could cut Canadian swine GHG emissions by 11.2 percent per kg carcass weight.
claims.source_title: Improving efficiency and reducing the environmental impact of pork production
claims.supporting_quote: This could lower greenhouse gas emissions by an estimated 11.2% per kg of carcass weight (0.75 Mt CO 2 eq in Canada and 39.6 Mt CO 2 eq worldwide on an annual basis).
